title: Talent Acquisition Manager (all genders)
description:
Talent Acquisition ist für uns mehr als Recruiting. Wir verstehen es als eine echte Disziplin, die sich stetig weiterentwickelt durch neue Technologien, neue Ansätze und vor allem durch die Menschen, die sie gestalten. Dabei zählt für uns nicht nur das Ergebnis, sondern auch der Weg dorthin. Und genau diesen Anspruch wollen wir mit dir weiterentwickeln.

 

Als Talent Acquisition Manager (all genders) übernimmst du die End-to-end-Verantwortung für deine Hiring-Prozesse und arbeitest eng mit unserem Talent-Team zusammen. Du bringst deine Persönlichkeit und deine Werte ein und hast gleichzeitig den Raum, neue Ideen auszuprobieren und Recruiting aktiv mitzugestalten.

 

Dabei unterstützt dich ein modernes, AI-gestütztes Setup mit Ashby als ATS, Metaview als AI-Notetaker sowie Claude, Notion und Gemini. Die Technologie nimmt dir dabei nicht das Recruiting ab, sie gibt dir mehr Raum für das, worauf es wirklich ankommt: Menschen zu verstehen, die richtigen Talente zu gewinnen und gemeinsam die besten Matches zu schaffen.

What to expect

- End-to-end Recruiting: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess, vom Hiring Kick-off und Talent Mapping bis hin zur Vertragsunterzeichnung

- Sparring Partner: Du bist ein vertrauenswürdiger Partner für Hiring Manager, forderst sie heraus und trägst durch deine Marktkenntnisse zur Entscheidungsfindung bei

- Pipeline Building: Du sprichst gezielt Talente über verschiedene Kanäle an und baust nachhaltige Talentpools durch Active Sourcing und Employer Branding Initiativen auf

- Data & Analytics: Deine Pipeline baust du basierend auf fundierten Daten und nutzt diese auch aktiv in der Hiring Manager Beratung

- Candidate Champion: Du optimierst gemeinsam mit dem Team unsere Prozesse und leitest eigene OKR-Projekte, um unsere Candidate Experience kontinuierlich zu verbessern

Inspire us by

- Background: Abgeschlossenes Studium und mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Recruiting von Business-Rollen in einem dynamischen Umfeld

- Expertise: Sehr gute Fachkenntnisse im in-house Recruiting, Erfahrung in der Einstellung von Entry-Level- bis Senior-Positionen

- Stakeholder Management: Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften und der Entwicklung langfristiger Talentstrategien durch Talentpools, Employer Branding Aktivitäten und innovative Talent Acquisition Ansätze

- Data-driven: Analytische Denkweise und die Fähigkeit, datenbasierte Entscheidungen zu treffen

- Tech-Affinität: Sicherer Umgang mit modernen ATS (idealerweise Ashby) und LinkedIn Recruiter sowie Lust, Recruiting-Technologien aktiv zu nutzen

- Sprachkenntnisse: Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. C1)

What we offer:

- Flexibilität & Eigenverantwortung: Dein Arbeitsalltag, deine Performance - Unser hybrides Modell ermöglicht dir fokussiertes arbeiten im Homeoffice, frische Perspektiven in der Workation sowie persönlichen Austausch an unseren Anchor-Days (Dienstag bis Donnerstag)

- Mobilität nach Maß: Volle Fahrt voraus - Ob nachhaltig mit Bike-Leasing oder bequem mit Fahrtkostenzuschuss, wir halten dich mobil und flexibel auf Kurs

- Ownership & Gestaltungsspielraum: Dein Impact, deine Bilanz - Übernimm volle Ownership für deinen Bereich und deine KPIs

- Teamkultur & Networking: Echte Verbindungen - auch abseits vom Daily Business. Feier Erfolge mit uns bei legendären Teamevents und Spirit Days

- Produktive Umgebung: Brainfood Deluxe - Ob Siebträger-Kaffee, Bella&Bona Online-Kantine, frisches Obst oder Müsli Bar. Dein Wohlbefinden ist die Basis für starke Performance

- Gesundheit & Ausgleich: Bleib in Balance mit EGYM Wellpass oder Urban Sports Club - deutschlandweit Zugang zu 1.000+ Sport- und Gesundheitseinrichtungen

- Top-Equipment & Ergonomie: Ob Mac oder Windows, im Office oder remote - Deine Effizienz und dein Arbeitskomfort kommen nicht zu kurz

- Dresscode? Dein Code: Bei uns zählt, was du bewegst - nicht, was du trägst. Zieh an, worin du dich am wohlsten fühlst

title: Categorie Protette (L. 68/99) – Customer Operations | Milano
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

Enpal è il green unicorn n. 1 in Europa.

Nata a Berlino nel 2017 e attiva in Italia dal 2023, Enpal conta più di 100.000 clienti soddisfatti. Il nostro obiettivo è diventare il punto di riferimento per l’indipendenza energetica dei nostri clienti a 360 gradi, attraverso soluzioni per l’energia solare, wallbox e pompe di calore, integrate con tecnologie innovative ed esperienze digitali.

Per sostenere la crescita di Enpal in Italia, siamo alla ricerca di nuove persone da inserire nel nostro team presso la sede di Milano.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Questa opportunità è riservata a candidati e candidate appartenenti alle Categorie Protette ai sensi della Legge 68/99.

Entrando a far parte di Enpal avrai l’opportunità di lavorare in un ambiente internazionale, dinamico e in forte crescita, contribuendo concretamente alla transizione energetica.

In base alla tua esperienza, alle tue competenze e alle esigenze del team, potrai supportare diverse attività nell’ambito Customer Operations, con particolare attenzione alla gestione dei clienti, degli appuntamenti e dei processi operativi.

Principali responsabilità

- Raccogliere e verificare informazioni relative alle esigenze e ai consumi energetici dei nostri clienti.

- Pianificare e confermare gli appuntamenti tra i nostri responsabili commerciali e i potenziali clienti interessati alle soluzioni Enpal.

- Gestire e aggiornare database e sistemi aziendali, garantendo accuratezza e qualità delle informazioni.

- Fornire assistenza ai clienti tramite telefono ed e-mail, contribuendo a garantire un’esperienza positiva durante tutto il percorso con Enpal.

- Supportare le attività operative e amministrative del team.

- Collaborare con i diversi dipartimenti per assicurare una gestione efficace delle richieste e dei processi.

- Contribuire al miglioramento continuo delle attività e dell’esperienza dei nostri clienti.

QUALIFICATIONS

- Appartenenza alle Categorie Protette ai sensi della Legge 68/99.

- Ottima conoscenza della lingua italiana, sia scritta che parlata.

- Buona dimestichezza con gli strumenti informatici e digitali.

- Precisione, affidabilità e capacità organizzative.

- Buone capacità comunicative e relazionali.

- Predisposizione alla collaborazione e al lavoro in team.

- Motivazione ad apprendere e a crescere professionalmente in un contesto dinamico.

Una precedente esperienza in ambito customer service, operations, back office o attività amministrative costituisce un plus, ma non è necessariamente richiesta.

COSA OFFRIAMO

- Assunzione diretta secondo le condizioni previste per il ruolo.

- Retribuzione competitiva e benefit secondo la policy aziendale.

- Formazione e onboarding per supportarti nell’inserimento e nello sviluppo del ruolo.

- Opportunità di crescita e sviluppo professionale.

- Un ambiente di lavoro internazionale, dinamico e collaborativo.

- La possibilità di proporre idee e contribuire direttamente alla crescita di Enpal in Italia.

- Un contesto attento alla diversità, all’inclusione e alla valorizzazione delle persone.

Orario: Full time, 40 ore settimanali o part time, 21 ore settimanali.

INFORMAZIONI AGGIUNTIVE

Da Enpal siamo orgogliosi della diversità del nostro team. Non vengono prese decisioni sulla base del colore della pelle, della religione o del credo religioso, dell'origine etnica o nazionale, della nazionalità, dell'identità di genere, dell'orientamento sessuale, della disabilità o dell'età, né durante l'assunzione né durante il rapporto di lavoro. Enpal è sinonimo di un posto di lavoro sicuro e combatte contro la discriminazione e le molestie di qualsiasi tipo.

description:
Roofing Outside Sales Trainee

Capstone Roofing | Santa Rosa, CA

Full-Time Exempt Outside Sales |   $40,000 base salary + uncapped 2% commission (Expected total annual compensation: $150K +, including base salary)+ $500 a month car allowance and a Fuel Card. 

ABOUT CAPSTONE ROOFING

Capstone Roofing is an established and trusted residential roofing company serving homeowners throughout Santa Rosa and the North Bay region of California. We have built our reputation on quality craftsmanship, professional service, and providing an exceptional customer experience from the initial inspection through project completion.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for a motivated, professional, and coachable Outside Roofing Sales Representative to join our Santa Rosa team.

ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

This is a full-time, exempt outside sales position working directly with homeowners throughout Santa Rosa and the surrounding North Bay area.

You will run sales leads, meet with homeowners at their properties, inspect roofing systems, prepare estimates and proposals, and present roofing solutions directly to the homeowner.

You do not need to come to us as a roofing expert. Capstone provides a structured training program that combines classroom instruction with hands-on field training. We will teach you our roofing products, inspection and estimating process, sales system, proposal process, and customer service standards.

We are looking for someone who is motivated to succeed, comfortable talking with homeowners, and willing to learn and follow a proven process.

COMPENSATION

• $40,000 base salary
• 2% commission on each sold job with uncapped earning potential
• $500 monthly vehicle allowance
• Company-provided fuel card
• Full benefits package
• Long-term career and advancement opportunities

This compensation structure provides the stability of a base salary along with uncapped commission earning potential based on your sales performance.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Run sales leads and meet with homeowners throughout the Santa Rosa and North Bay market
• Conduct residential roof inspections and evaluate homeowners' roofing needs
• Safely use a ladder and access residential roofs as part of the inspection and estimating process
• Take measurements, photos, and gather information needed to prepare accurate estimates
• Develop professional roofing estimates and proposals
• Present proposals directly to homeowners and explain products, scope of work, pricing, and next steps
• Build trust with homeowners and provide a professional, consultative sales experience
• Consistently follow up with prospective customers and move opportunities through the sales process
• Maintain accurate customer and sales information within company systems
• Work closely with Production and Operations to ensure a smooth handoff after a project is sold
• Participate in ongoing classroom training, field coaching, ride-alongs, and sales development
• Represent Capstone Roofing professionally throughout the community

TRAINING & DEVELOPMENT

Capstone Roofing invests in developing our sales professionals. New Sales Representatives will receive extensive training that includes:

• Classroom-based roofing and sales training
• Hands-on field training
• Roof inspection and estimating instruction
• Ride-alongs with experienced team members and leadership
• Proposal and presentation training
• Customer communication and sales process training
• Ongoing coaching and professional development

You bring the attitude, effort, communication skills, and willingness to learn. We will provide the training and tools to help you become successful in roofing sales.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We care more about work ethic, coachability, professionalism, accountability, and the ability to build relationships than having years of previous roofing experience.

Successful candidates will be:

• Highly motivated and driven to succeed
• Comfortable meeting and communicating with homeowners face-to-face

title: Strategic Sourcing Leader, Professional Services
description:
About the Team

OpenAI Finance helps ensure the organisation is positioned for long-term success as we pursue our mission. The Strategic Sourcing & Procurement team helps OpenAI scale responsibly and at speed by choosing the right external partners, structuring strong commercial agreements and building resilient supplier relationships. We partner with teams across the company to turn rapidly evolving needs into practical, economically sound solutions.

Professional Services provides specialist expertise and capacity across OpenAI, spanning consulting and advisory, finance and accounting, legal, people-related services and managed services. Our sourcing team helps business leaders define the outcomes they need, select capable partners and establish clear commercial and delivery accountability.

About the Role

We are seeking a Strategic Sourcing Leader to lead and develop the Professional Services sourcing team and set direction across its portfolio. This is a people-management role with accountability for team performance, commercial quality, stakeholder experience and sustained business outcomes. You will translate business priorities into category strategies, achievable delivery plans and clear decision authority, while developing the judgement and independence of experienced sourcing professionals.

You will oversee a broad portfolio, from strategic advisory relationships and enterprise programmes to a high volume of statements of work and renewals. You will remain hands-on in selected complex negotiations and critical decisions, while enabling the team to own and deliver its work. Working with senior leaders across Finance, Accounting, Legal, People, Extended Workforce and the business, you will create clarity from incomplete information, resolve competing priorities and adapt the team's approach as OpenAI grows.

We are seeking insurance professionals with 2 to 5 years of commercial insurance experience and an active P&C license, for current and future opportunities within our Account Management career path based on experience and licensing. Multiple experience levels considered, including Account Associate, Senior Account Associate and Account Manager Associate opportunities.
Provide administrative, technical, and customer service support to the account team and assigned clients. This role ensures accurate policy processing, supports new and renewal business, and maintains high service standards while minimizing risk exposure.

Client Service & Support

Policy Administration

• Manage certificates, ID cards, binders, invoices, and related documents

• Support policy issuance and documentation accuracy

Business & Renewal Support

• Assist or lead new and renewal business processes

• Prepare submissions and proposals

• Gather underwriting information and documentation

Systems & Workflow Management

• Maintain accurate client and policy data in systems

• Monitor activities and ensure timely task completion

Billing & Compliance

• Resolve billing discrepancies and support collections

• Ensure adherence to policies and minimize errors & omissions exposure

Level Differentiation
Account Associate (AA) (Non-Exempt)- Foundational

• Executes transactional and administrative tasks

• Supports workflows under close supervision

• Assists with submissions and policy processing

• Focused on accuracy, timeliness, and task completion

Senior Account Associate (SAA) (Non-Exempt)- Intermediate

• Performs in-depth coverage analysis and advisory support

• Handles more complex accounts and escalations

• Demonstrates advanced technical expertise and leadership

Differences Summary

•
Account Associate: Task-driven, execution-focused, entry-level support

•
Senior Account Associate: Independent contributor, analytical, manages smaller accounts

•
Account Manager Associate: Advanced expertise, owns client experience, near Account Manager level

title: Customer Success Manager - EMEA
description:
Fingerprint empowers enterprises to detect and stop online fraud with the world’s most accurate device intelligence. We lead our industry with bleeding-edge identification capabilities and work on turning new ideas and discoveries in the fraud detection space into reality. Our customers range from innovative startups to leading enterprise companies, including Plaid, Dropbox, and Booking.com.

Fingerprint is a globally dispersed, 100% remote company. We were named on on the 2026 Forbes Best Startup Employers list and ranked #803 on the 2026 Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies.

We have raised $77M and are backed by Craft Ventures (Tesla, Facebook, Airbnb ), Nexus Venture Partners ( Postman, Apollo.io,MinIO, Druva) and Uncorrelated Ventures ( Redis, Rollbar, Gradle).

Location Preference: Remote, anywhere in the EMEA region

About The Role:

The Customer Success Team is the trusted advisor for building relationships, driving product adoption, and empowering our customers to achieve their goals. The Customer Success Manager acts as a trusted advisor for a variety of customers who represent various industries. You will support them on their journey to successfully onboard, increase user adoption and ultimately ensure a positive renewal outcome.

Responsibilities:

• Lead the transition from contract signature to implementation through to go-live

• Proactively manage a portfolio of clients, ensuring value realization and satisfaction with the product is achieved

• Conduct regular meetings including integration reviews, quarterly business review, and onsite meetings with clients to make recommendations and highlight successes

• Work closely with Customer Success Engineer, a support team, and product managers to resolve implementation issues, bugs, and feature requests

• Initiate conversations to uncover additional uses for Fingerprint as upsell and cross-sell motions

• Actively monitor the health of your client portfolio, identifying risks and managing escalations

• Drive renewals with executive level stakeholders, day-to-day contacts, and procurement teams

• Create and execute a success plan to achieve 120% NRR and 90% GRR within your book of business

• Maintain up to date records in Salesforce and Planhat, providing feedback to help the CS team processes scale

• Travel may be required

Qualifications:

• 6-10 years experience in a Mid-Market/Enterprise Customer Success Manager role

• B2B SaaS, tech, and/or cybersecurity industry experience highly preferred

• Experience handling the full customer journey from onboarding to renewals; cross-sell and upsell experience is a huge plus!

• Experience working in a Customer Success Platform (ie. Gainsight, Planhat, etc.), Zendesk, and Salesforce preferred

• Comfortable operating in a fully remote, async-first environment

• Proficiency utilizing AI to increase efficiency of day to day tasks (ideally Claude and Gemini)

• Role requires proficiency with macOS and comfort working fully remotely using tools such as Slack, Google Workspace, and Zoom.

• Balances proactive and reactive customer needs; effectively prioritizing internal and external tasks

• Effective at leading and facilitating meetings with attendees ranging from technical contacts to executive stakeholders

• Strong communication skills; you pride yourself on being personable, concise and compelling communicator - in writing, in conversation, and in front of an audience

• Empathy, diplomacy, and poise under pressure when working through customer concerns

• Put team above yourself - elevating the group's performance through proactive collaboration and knowledge-sharing

Compensation & Transparency

At Fingerprint , we believe in pay transparency - it's part of how we operate as a distributed, remote-first team. Salaries are based on function, level, and geographic location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies.

Job Summary
The Program Manager I will provide program management, technical, and coordination support to EMPOWER partners in South America to strengthen El Niño preparedness and readiness for rapid, partner-led emergency response. The position will support implementation of preparedness activities across priority countries and hotspots, helping translate hazard, vulnerability, market, operational, and partner-capacity information into practical readiness actions, quality program designs, and activation-ready response plans.
Working under the guidance of the Program Manager II and in coordination with technical, MEAL, supply chain, finance, safeguarding, and operations colleagues, the Program Manager I will accompany partners to complete priority preparedness deliverables, address program bottlenecks, test readiness arrangements, and maintain country-level materials that can be rapidly adapted when an EMPOWER/RAPID response is activated.

• Support implementation of the El Niño preparedness workplans across assigned South America countries or hotspots in coordination with EMPOWER partners, country teams, RAPID counterparts, and technical and operational colleagues.

• Coordinate routine follow-up with supply chain and operations colleagues so proposed relief kits, in-kind assistance, and cash or voucher options reflect assessed needs, market capacity, cultural appropriateness, protection considerations, delivery feasibility, lead times, and cost drivers.

• Incorporate validated market and logistics findings into program drafts, implementation schedules, modality recommendations, delivery sequencing, contingency options, and procurement inputs.

• Support partner readiness for cash and voucher assistance, including participant-data requirements, accountability and complaints mechanisms, protection and inclusion measures, reconciliation processes, monitoring, and failed-payment follow-up.

• Prepare and update activation-ready program materials, including rapid assessment tools, response concept drafts, targeting and registration approaches, implementation plans, staffing assumptions, budget inputs, procurement requests, risk registers, and donor narrative inputs.

title: Generation Lead, Fuel-Based Generation
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

The Power Generation Team

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Build an islanded grid at gigawatt scale, from a blank sheet. Generation, storage and compute running with no utility behind them, where the machine you design is the only thing holding voltage. No playbook exists at this size, so the architecture you set becomes the reference.

- Get power online in months, not years. Interconnection queues are measured in years and we do not have them. Generating our own power is how a site goes from signed lease to live compute inside six months, and the power system is the long pole in that plan.

- Make one power block, then build it a thousand times. A repeatable block and cluster unit, validated once and stamped across the fleet, is the only route to the scale we are targeting. Every bespoke site is schedule we do not get back.

- Design a grid whose largest load answers back. Compute is not passive demand here. Load behaviour, curtailment and shedding are design variables you negotiate and specify, a lever almost no power system engineer has ever been handed.

Role Scope

- Assess and qualify every fuel-oxidation generation technology worth considering for our blocks, from reciprocating engines and turbines to linear generators, and build the qualified technology and supplier list Fluidstack buys from.

- Set the standard interface that turns any engine, turbine or fuel cell into one interchangeable node in the site's decentralized generation array, with a defined electrical connection, control signals, telemetry and operating envelope, so the plant controller dispatches it alongside PV and BESS without bespoke integration.

- Decide how much fuel-based capacity each block carries, in what unit sizes and with what redundancy, for its firming and backup role, and hold that decision against cost, fuel use and uptime as the block design evolves.

- Write the technical specification and acceptance tests for each qualified unit, covering step-load acceptance, ramp rate, minimum load, start reliability, heat rate across the load range and emissions, and witness factory and site acceptance before a unit is accepted.

- Own installation and commissioning of the generation fleet through first fire, load testing against real AI load profiles and handover, and fold every field finding back into the specification.

title: IT System Administrator (m/f/d)
description:
ÜBER BUENA

Buena (finanziert von Google Ventures) macht alles rund um Immobilien so einfach und transparent wie den Kauf eines ETFs. Wir übernehmen deutschlandweit Hausverwaltungen und machen sie digital. In den vergangenen drei Jahren sind wir mit rund 25 Vollzeitmitarbeitern in Berlin zur zweitgrößten Hausverwaltung Deutschlands geworden.

 

ÜBER DIE ROLLE

Wir suchen einen Systemadministrator (m/f/d), der unsere IT im Griff hat. Dazu gehören das Google-Konto jedes Mitarbeitenden, jeder Laptop und das Netzwerk im Büro.

Mit jeder übernommenen Hausverwaltung wächst unsere IT. Deshalb braucht es jemanden, der Ordnung schafft und sie hält.

Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Head of Product zusammen und bist erster Ansprechpartner für alle IT-Fragen im Büro.

VERANTWORTLICHKEITEN

Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere IT in Berlin rund läuft. Mittelfristig begleitest du auch die IT-Einbindung neu übernommener Hausverwaltungen. Das machst du gemeinsam mit unserem externen IT-Partner, damit jeder Standort unserem Standard entspricht.

 

GOOGLE WORKSPACE

- Du verwaltest Nutzer, Gruppen, Organisationseinheiten und Berechtigungen.

- Du pflegst die Sicherheitseinstellungen, zum Beispiel Zwei-Faktor-Anmeldung, Passwortregeln und Zugriffsrechte.

- Du verwaltest geteilte Ablagen, Freigaben und Lizenzen.

EIN- UND AUSTRITTE VON MITARBEITENDEN

- Du richtest neue Mitarbeitende ein: Konten, Lizenzen, Berechtigungen und Geräte.

- Du bereitest Laptops und Diensthandys vor und gibst sie aus.

- Wenn jemand das Unternehmen verlässt, entziehst du Zugänge, sicherst Daten und nimmst Geräte zurück.

- Du entwickelst diese Abläufe weiter und dokumentierst sie sauber.

GERÄTEVERWALTUNG

- Du verwaltest alle Geräte in NinjaOne. Dazu gehören Überwachung, Updates und Softwareverteilung.

- Apple-Geräte verwaltest du zusätzlich über den Apple Business Manager.

NETZWERK UND BÜRO-IT

- Du betreust unser Netzwerk am Hauptstandort, das auf Ubiquiti UniFi läuft.

- Du hilfst Kolleginnen und Kollegen vor Ort, von der einfachen Frage bis zur Fehlersuche.

DU PASST, WENN DU

- vor Ort in unserem Büro in Berlin (Prenzlauer Berg) arbeiten willst.

- sehr gut Deutsch und gut Englisch sprichst.

- eine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation hast. Einschlägige Praxiserfahrung zählt genauso.

- mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in der Verwaltung von Google Workspace mitbringst.

- NinjaOne oder vergleichbare Software wie Jamf oder Intune kennst.

- dich mit macOS, iOS und dem Apple Business Manager auskennst.

- Grundkenntnisse in Netzwerktechnik hast, idealerweise mit UniFi.

DEINE BENEFITS

- Aufstiegschancen in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Startups Europas.

- MacBook & Studio Display.

- Attraktives Gehalt, inklusive 500 € „Close-to-Office"-Bonus.

- 110 € Essenszuschuss und 50 € Fitnesszuschuss.

- Bücher: Buena zahlt jedes Buch, das du lesen willst.

- Tägliches Frühstück und Spezialitätenkaffee im Büro.

WARUM JETZT EINSTEIGEN

- Wir wachsen schnell mit einem kleinen Team: In den letzten 3 Jahren zur zweitgrößten Hausverwaltung Deutschlands mit rund 25 Vollzeitmitarbeitern.

- Wir sind meritokratisch: Wer liefert, bekommt Verantwortung. Unser CEO war vor 3 Jahren Junior Product Manager, unser COO vor 2 Jahren Chief of Staff.

- Wir bauen Buena langfristig auf: Die Wohneigentumsquote in Deutschland liegt weit unter dem europäischen Durchschnitt. Buena wird das ändern.

· Your resume

Responsibilities

• Assess the existing New Relic monitoring setup for the in-scope application, including dashboards, alerts, SLIs/SLOs, synthetic checks, and log and trace usage.

• Define the migration approach and map New Relic constructs to their Grafana-stack equivalents (Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo or similar).

Instrument and configure the application and its AWS infrastructure (such as compute, containers, load balancers, and managed services) to send metrics, logs, and traces to the new platform, using OpenTelemetry where applicable.

• Set up and validate secure network connectivity between AWS workloads and the Grafana stack, including VPC routing, security groups, VPC endpoints or PrivateLink, and DNS, and troubleshoot connectivity and data-flow issues.

• Run the old and new monitoring in parallel, verify data accuracy, and manage a safe cutover with minimal risk to production visibility; integrate and tune alerting with the team's incident and notification channels.

• Use AI-assisted development tools, including Codex, to improve engineering productivity and delivery speed, for example to translate queries, generate dashboards and configuration as code, and draft documentation, while reviewing and validating all output.

• Document the new setup, hand over knowledge to the team with runbooks, and keep stakeholders informed with regular progress updates and early risk flags.

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or observability engineering, ideally in a high-traffic, cloud-based production environment.

• Strong hands-on experience with Grafana, including dashboard design, alerting, and data source configuration.

• Practical experience with New Relic (APM, dashboards, NRQL, alert policies) and a clear understanding of how to translate it to other tools.

• Experience with Prometheus (PromQL), log and trace tooling such as Loki, Tempo, or the ELK stack, and OpenTelemetry instrumentation.

• Solid hands-on experience with AWS infrastructure, such as EC2, EKS/ECS, IAM, CloudWatch, and S3, and with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform).

• Strong understanding of AWS networking, including VPC design, subnets, routing, security groups, load balancers, VPC endpoints/PrivateLink, and DNS (Route 53).

• Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools, such as Codex, in day-to-day engineering work.

• Proven ability to work independently and deliver within a tight timeline, with availability to work full-time within Canadian time zone hours and start on short notice.

• Excellent verbal and written English skills.

Nice to have

• Experience with Grafana Cloud or Grafana Mimir.

• Previous monitoring or observability tool migration projects.

• Experience defining SLIs/SLOs and error budgets.

• AWS certification (e.g., Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, or Advanced Networking)

NB! Working hours according to the Canadian Timez

Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner - PMHNP - Telehealth Addiction Care
Affect Therapeutics is transforming addiction recovery by combining mobile technology with counseling and medical care, offering 100% virtual treatment. We break down barriers to care, making it more accessible and effective for our members.
Our innovative approach combines a smartphone app with a dedicated care team to provide real-time, data-driven treatment for improved outcomes and reduced costs. We are backed by industry leaders and investors, including City Light Ventures and Kapor Capital.

As a PMHNP, you'll lead member care, supported by a team of counselors and case managers. You’ll deliver evidence-based treatment for Stimulant Use Disorder and Alcohol Use Disorder via telehealth. We don’t prescribe controlled substances, and medication decisions are made at the provider's discretion. You must hold an active, unrestricted license in the state you're applying for.

• Monitor progress through monthly appointments.

• Minimum 2 years of experience, preferably in addiction treatment.

• Must have experience prescribing Suboxone and an active DEA (Drug Enforcement Administration) registration.

• Empathy for members facing personal and emotional challenges.

• Comfort with technology, including EHRs and mobile apps.

You’ll need a private, quiet home office with reliable internet for HIPAA-compliant conversations. This role may involve periodic meetings with Affect ’s internal teams, and reasonable accommodations can be made if needed.

title: Consulting AI Research Contributor
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Aptura is looking for Subject Matter Experts from management or strategy consulting, in an industry or functional practice, who build market sizing models, competitive landscapes and business cases in Excel. You have used AI tools on your own work and been frustrated by the mistakes they make. You will turn that experience into realistic Excel tasks that test how well AI does the work of a Consultant.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Writing realistic Excel tasks drawn from your own work: extending existing models, fixing broken ones and building from a brief

- Working through each task yourself so there is a clear, correct answer

- Writing yes-or-no criteria precise enough that a grader can mark any attempt against them

NECESSARY QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years in management, strategy or operations consulting, in an industry practice (e.g. financial services, healthcare, TMT, consumer, energy, public sector) or a functional practice (strategy, operations, pricing, due diligence)

- Deep hands-on Excel: market sizing, competitive landscapes, goal seek, data reshaping and clear workbook structure

- Strong written English communication skills.

- Attention to detail, and willingness to learn concepts in AI and Evals

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

- Start Date : Immediate

- Duration: Approximately 4-6 weeks

- Payment: task-based. Experts who complete their first task within the required timeline will then be qualified to do multiple tasks for the remainder of the project.

CONTRACT AND PAYMENT TERMS

- You will be engaged as an independent contractor.

- This is a fully remote role that can be completed on your own schedule.

- Projects can be extended, shortened, or concluded early depending on needs and performance.

- Your work at Aptura will not involve access to confidential or proprietary information from any employer, client, or institution.

- Payments will be weekly following task completion.

GETTING STARTED

- Apply with your details and CV. Choose an available 30-minute group walkthrough call.

- Attend the walkthrough and create one original task from your own work. Submit the brief, the actual input workbook(s) needed to complete it. Input-file uploads are compulsory.

- Write the brief yourself. Input workbooks must also be human-built. Use real data that has been sanitised, or public data with the source named. No AI usage allowed.

- We run your task against current frontier AI models. If the models get it wrong, you then write a detailed yes-or-no rubric, and a reviewer signs off on the task with you.

- Completing onboarding does not guarantee a job offer; selection remains subject to written approval of the task proposal.

ABOUT APTURA

Aptura is an applied AI and data company working with frontier labs to train AI systems on real professional work. We do this by building high-quality evaluation and training environments that teach AI agents to produce work that can be used in daily workflows.

Job Title: In-Home Physician Per Diem - Medford

We’re building a world of health around every individual - shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Per Diem Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD
“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD
Per diem employees qualify for:

• Hourly base rate, plus additional incentive structure (i.e., per visit completed, other incentives may apply)

• Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

• Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

• Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

• Multi-state licenses (preferred)

Anticipated Weekly Hours
12 Time

title: Senior Recruiter, Strategic Recruitment
description:
Stand Together is a philanthropic community that helps America’s boldest changemakers tackle the root causes of our country’s biggest problems, from education to the economy, broken communities, and toxic division, among dozens of other pressing issues. We provide our partners with access to resources including funding, thought leadership, a network of peers, and a playbook for applying proven principles to transform lives and society. 

As Senior Recruiter, you will lead the recruitment for a portfolio of roles with our Executive and Strategic Recruitment capability. This role will operate in both a split-desk and full-desk model (role dependent): you will source, screen, and pipeline top-tier talent with a focus on quality of hire, speed, and a white-glove candidate experience for our priority talent needs. 
You will apprentice with talent acquisition leaders and colleagues to build knowledge of theStand Together community, our organizational priorities,ideal candidate profiles, and recruitment strategies.As a member of the Strategic Recruitment team, you will play a pivotal role in building and supporting teams and capabilities that are driving long-term, transformational change to drive progress on some of our country's most pressing problems. 

Our Values: Working for an organization within the Stand Together philanthropic community is different from many other places. The culture is deeply rooted in Principle Based Management® (PBM®), a framework guided by the principles that drive human progress, such as dignity, openness, and bottom-up empowerment. PBM® empowers employees to be entrepreneurial, to innovate, and to continually drive transformation.   
 
We believe diversity fuels creativity, broadens knowledge, and helps drive success.  That is why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and strive to treat all employees and applicants with honesty, dignity, and respect.

title: Account Executive, Mid Market (TOLA)
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara , we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing - and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:
This is a dynamic, high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara 's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $20k to $100k, and involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.
This role is open for candidates residing in the following US states: Texas, Oklahoma, Louisiana, Arkansas, Kansas, Missouri, Mississippi, Alabama. The role requires travel approximately 25% of the time.

You should apply if:

•
You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact-helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

•
Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara ’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.

•
You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.

•
You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.

•
You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.

•
You want to be with the best: Samsara ’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

Minimum requirements for this role:

• 2+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role

• Experience independently closing new deals larger than $10,000 in annual revenue

• All candidates must be located in one of the following US states: Texas, Oklahoma, Louisiana, Arkansas, Kansas, Missouri, Mississippi, Alabama.

An ideal candidate has:

• Proven track record of consistent quota achievement

• Experience selling in the midmarket space - medium to large deals sizes

• Experience with high-volume cold calling

• Must demonstrate a growth mindset and a willingness to be collaborative with your teammates and in your selling process

• SFDC familiarity

title: Audit Operations Lead
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

You will run the external audit calendar for our SOX 404 program as we scale toward an IPO. That means coordinating with our external auditors across the year, aligning testing windows with control owners, educating our control owners, and keeping requests and deliverables on schedule. You will also own SOX scoping and risk assessment cycles, deficiency tracking, and status reporting, and help roll out our GRC platform so the program runs from one system of record instead of spreadsheets. You will scale the program through AI-enabled workflows that reduce manual effort and speed up our SOX program.

This role reports to the Head of Business Controls and works closely with everyone on the SOX and Internal Audit team. This is an individual contributor role for someone who keeps a complex program on schedule, writes clearly, and makes the program simpler each cycle.

Key responsibilities

• Own the annual SOX audit calendar, including interim and year-end testing windows, walkthrough schedules, and key deliverable dates agreed with external auditors.

• Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for external auditor requests. Triage, route, and track each request to closure, including PBC (provided-by-client) lists and evidence deliveries.

• Coordinate auditor walkthroughs and fieldwork with process owners, control owners, and the SOX Testing team, so each control owner is asked for the same evidence once.

• Track auditor findings, management responses, and deficiency follow-ups, and report status to Internal Audit leadership.

• Prepare control owners and process owners for auditor sessions, and get evidence delivered on time without direct authority over them.

• Lead the annual SOX scoping and risk assessment, including quarterly refreshes, and support the annual Fraud Risk Assessment, so the program has appropriate scope and coverage under COSO.

• Monitor BP and IT SOX testing and report status to leadership and share status with external auditors

• Lead work with the business to improve control documentation, including education of templates and SOX guidance.

• Find optimization and automation opportunities across the SOX lifecycle through the use of AI.

• Support the rollout of the GRC tool for SOX, including control libraries, workflows, evidence requests, and testing templates.

• Define the data and reporting requirements the platform must meet, and test that it produces what the program needs.

• Run the quarterly sub-certification process and report results to leadership

• Own SOX program status reporting: dashboards and metrics for leadership, audit calendar progress, and deficiency and remediation status.

• Own status reporting for the full SOX lifecycle: scoping and risk assessment, testing, deficiencies and remediation, segregation of duties (SOD), SOC 1 report reviews, the fraud risk assessment, and audit calendar progress.

Minimum qualifications

• Big 4 audit firm experience on SOX 404 or ICFR engagements, including managing audit calendars, PBC requests, and fieldwork with external audit teams.

• Experience working directly with external auditor teams on requests, testing schedules, and findings, from the company side.

• Several years of hands-on SOX 404 experience, including scoping, risk assessment, control documentation, testing, and deficiency evaluation.

• Working knowledge of the COSO framework, ICFR, and PCAOB standards.

• Experience developing or maintaining Risk and Control Matrices and process documentation or flowcharts.

• Experience implementing or administering a GRC systems

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato .

YOUR ROLE
You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.
Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.
This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.

By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own.

• Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier

• Carrier conversion data running in production models

• Automated marketplace bidding taken from proof of concept to scale

• A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions

• Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives

• Output the business trusts and uses without rework

MUST HAVE

• 5+ years of hands-on applied data science with measurable business impact

• Your models drove paid media decisions: spend, bidding or ad serving. Attribution and reporting alone don't qualify.

• You built what's on your resume and can explain it down to the loss function and architecture choice, neural network fundamentals included

• You see how today's bids shape tomorrow's training data, and you've handled late labels, sparse features or drift

• You own models end to end: you find your own data, build through deployment and monitoring, and bring a point of view

• Expert Python and SQL

• Real ad budget spent in live auctions

• Explaining tradeoffs to non-technical partners in plain terms

• Designing for auction feedback loops, selection bias and exploration

• Hands-on neural network work, such as embeddings of text, creative or user behavior

• AWS for data science: ECS, S3, Athena, SageMaker

• CI/CD deployment

title: Manager, Government Compliance & Authorization
description:
Company Description

At Amwell , we’re transforming healthcare for all-powered by technology and inspired by people. Here, your ideas don’t just matter-they drive real change, improving lives on a global scale.

We marry technology and innovation with clinical excellence to provide trusted solutions that solve the healthcare industry’s biggest pain points and are on a mission to enable greater access to more convenient, affordable, and effective care.

We do this through our technology-enabled care platform that is designed to help our clients achieve their digital care ambitions - today and in the future. We offer programs spanning the full care continuum , including urgent, acute and specialty care, behavioral health, and services for the treatment of chronic conditions such as heart and cardiometabolic diseases. Programs are powered by Amwell as well as our growing partner network.

For almost two decades, Amwell has proudly served some of the largest and most sophisticated healthcare organizations in the U.S. and worldwide. Our team is passionate about technology’s role in transforming care delivery and making it more equitable, accessible, efficient, cost-effective and navigable for all.

Brief Overview
The Manager of Government Compliance & Authorization will lead the strategy, implementation, and maintenance of Amwell ’s federal and state authorization programs. While a primary focus remains achieving and sustaining FedRAMP High authorization, this leader will also architect the internal systems necessary to align with CMMC (Level 2/3), CMS MARS-E, and StateRAMP requirements. The Manager will mature Amwell ’s government compliance program, oversee the authorization process, lead efforts to define resources and hire staff to support the program, manage continuous monitoring activities, and serve as the primary liaison with federal stakeholders and third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs). The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in FedRAMP High requirements, strong project management skills, and the ability to work cross-functionally to implement and maintain complex compliance frameworks.
Core Responsibilities
· Lead the end-to-end authorization process for FedRAMP High, while concurrently driving alignment with CMMC Level 2/3 for DoD contracts and MARS-E 2.2 for CMS/Medicaid engagements
· Manage ongoing FedRAMP continuous monitoring requirements, including monthly deliverables, vulnerability management, and incident reporting to federal agencies
· Collaborate with engineering, security, and operations teams to develop a "comply once, satisfy many" strategy by mapping NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 controls to CMMC (NIST SP 800-171) and MARS-E requirements to minimize redundant engineering efforts
· Own risk management of services provided to federal agencies, ensuring compliance with High-impact baseline
· Coordinate with 3PAOs to manage security assessment and authorization (SA&A) activities, including annual assessments and significant change requests
· Develop and maintain FedRAMP authorization packages, including System Security Plans (SSP), Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&M), and Continuous Monitoring deliverables
· Serve as primary point of contact for federal agency customers regarding FedRAMP compliance questions and authorization boundary matters
· Monitor and interpret FedRAMP policy updates and guidance from the FedRAMP PMO, implementing necessary changes to maintain compliance
· Build and lead a team of compliance analysts and security specialists focused on federal authorization requirements
· Create and deliver training programs to ensure organizational awareness of FedRAMP requirements and responsibilities
· Manage relationships with federal authorizing officials, cloud service providers, and other stakeholders in the authorization process
Qualifications
· 7+ years of experience in information security, compliance, or risk management with at least 3 years specifically working with FedRAMP authorization

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
About Handtevy

Handtevy is a leading provider of pediatric and adult emergency care solutions. Our SaaS platform is used by hospitals, EMS agencies, and fire departments to deliver evidence-based medication dosing, standardized clinical protocols, and real-time coordination tools for emergency medical services. Our software is used in ambulances and emergency departments every day, in moments where clarity, speed, and reliability are not optional.
About the Role
We're looking for a senior software engineer to own the design and delivery of our API integration platform. This is the layer that connects Handtevy to other medical systems, including ePCR, EHR, narcotic and blood tracking systems, and more. You'll be the technical lead on how third-party systems authenticate, consume, and rely on our APIs, with real ownership in architecture decisions as well as implementation. This is critical work with real impact!
What You'll Do

• Design and build bi-directional integrations between Handtevy and third-party platforms.

• Design RESTful APIs with clear versioning, pagination, and idempotency guarantees, documented via OpenAPI/Swagger

• Implement and harden authentication and authorization flows, including API key management, for third-party access

• Build resilient, observable webhook and event-driven integration patterns

• Own reliability, testing, and documentation standards for the integration layer, including security controls

• Partner directly with integration vendors and internal product/frontend teams (product management, customer success, clinical, and implementation) to scope and ship new integrations

• Evolve our public-facing API into a partner platform

What You'll Bring

• 5+ years of backend software engineering experience, including meaningful work on API platforms or system integrations

• Strong hands-on expertise with Node.js and NestJS (or comparable backend frameworks) and TypeScript

• Deep working knowledge of OAuth 2.0, JWT, SSO/SAML, and API security best practices

• Production experience with relational databases (MySQL/Aurora preferred) and NoSQL stores (MongoDB, DocumentDB, etc.)

• Comfort with Docker, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar), and AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS/SNS/EventBridge, CloudWatch)

• Real AI-augmented engineering practices

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience

Nice to Have

• Healthcare interoperability experience (HL7, FHIR, NEMSIS, etc.), and/or work with EHR/ePCR platforms

• Healthcare, EMS, or other regulated-industry background

• Familiarity with PHP and Laravel

• Event-driven architecture experience: Kafka, Kinesis, EventBridge, or similar

• Observability platforms: Datadog, New Relic, or similar

Benefits

• Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage.

• 401(k) with company match

• Paid time off and paid holidays

description:
ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE :
École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.
Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.
IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.
Le poste est ouvert au sein le centre RAPSODEE (Recherche d'Albi en génie des Procédés des Solides Divisés, de l'Énergie et de l'Environnement) UMR CNRS 5302 d’IMT Mines Albi, dans le cadre du projet de collaboration avec GRDF sur l’intégration de nouveaux gaz renouvelables dans le réseau de gaz naturel.
Les activités du centre RAPSODEE sont structurées en deux groupes de recherche dans les domaines de l’énergie, de l’environnement et du génie particulaire avec un accent particulier sur des procédés durables : plus intenses, plus économes en énergie, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus sûrs. La plateforme VALTHERA est rattachée au centre RAPSODEE. Les travaux réalisés sur la plateforme le sont essentiellement à l’échelle pilote et sont centrés sur les procédés thermochimiques pour la production d’énergies renouvelables.
GRDF est le gestionnaire du plus grand réseau de distribution de gaz en Europe. GRDF s’inscrit dans une trajectoire de décarbonation, avec une volonté de multiplier par cinq la production de gaz renouvelable pour attendre 20% de gaz renouvelable dans le réseau GRDF à l’échéance 2030, mais également d’aider les consommateurs de gaz à réduire leur empreinte carbone. Dans ce cadre, GRDF souhait renforcer la connaissance et maîtrise des procédés d'épuration du syngaz, étape clé pour garantir sa compatibilité avec les procédés de méthanation et, à terme, la production de méthane conforme aux exigences d’injection dans le réseau de gaz.
DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :
En qualité d’ingénieur de recherche, vous intégrerez une équipe comprenant des ingénieurs, techniciens et enseignants chercheurs travaillant dans la recherche sur les procédés thermiques de valorisation de biomasse et déchets.
Le projet que vous devrez développer cherche à analyser les différentes technologies d’épuration à intégrer dans une chaîne d’épuration globale de gaz de synthèse. La chaîne d’épuration a un impact conséquent sur les coûts d’investissement et d’opérations du procédé de production de biogaz par gazéification de biomasse ou déchets. Il est essentiel de simplifier le schéma d’épuration et d’essayer de minimiser la génération d’effluents afin de réduire les coûts des opérations unitaires. Le choix des briques technologiques dépend de la qualité du gaz de synthèse produit qui dépend du gisement utilisé, de la technologie du gazéifieur et des conditions opératoires.
Le projet n’inclut pas de travail expérimental. Il sera basé exclusivement sur l’analyse bibliographique et la modélisation 0D de la chaîne d’épuration. La modélisation sera réalisée via des logiciels commerciaux et plus idéalement grâce à des logiciels Open source.

Position Overview
As a Senior Research Scientist in the AI Lab at Autodesk Research, you will conduct fundamental and applied research on Motion Foundation Models: general-purpose models that can represent, generate, edit, understand, and reason about motion. The work will initially focus on human and object motion and will extend toward multimodal and interactive settings involving text, trajectories, images, video, geometry, robot observations/actions, and other signals.

You will work with scientists, researchers, developers, and designers across generative AI, computer vision, graphics, robotics, simulation, manufacturing, architecture, and construction to develop new model architectures, representations, training methods, datasets, and evaluations for motion intelligence.

Autodesk 's AI Lab is active in the wider research community, targeting publications at CVPR, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, SIGGRAPH, and other top-tier conferences. We collaborate with leading academic and industry labs, combining the best of an academic research environment with product-guided research. This role will report to a Manager of Research Science in the AI Lab.

Responsibilities

• Develop new foundation-model approaches for motion generation, editing, understanding, reasoning, and representation

• Drive research end-to-end: identify high-value questions, formulate hypotheses, implement ideas, run experiments, analyze failures, iterate, and communicate conclusions

• Investigate motion representations and tokenization, generative modeling, multimodal conditioning and alignment, scalable training, post-training, and model refinement

• Work toward ambitious long-term goals while defining concrete milestones and maintaining a high pace of empirical iteration

• Collaborate across a global research team and with academic and industry partners; publish at top-tier conferences and help transfer successful ideas into Autodesk technologies

Minimum Qualifications

• A Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Computer Graphics, Robotics, Mathematics, or a related technical field

• A consistent track record of research publications demonstrating experience in applied or fundamental research

• Deep knowledge of modern generative or foundation-model methods, such as Transformers, diffusion/flow models, latent-variable models, or related architectures

• Strong hands-on ability with PyTorch, JAX, or similar frameworks, including building, modifying, debugging, and scaling research training pipelines; effective use of modern AI-assisted development and coding agents

• Excellent experimental judgment: ability to turn ambiguous research questions into testable hypotheses, controlled experiments, useful metrics, and clear conclusions

• Experience with learned motion representations or tokenization (for example VQ/VAE-style methods) and generative methods such as diffusion, flow matching, or autoregressive modeling

title: Senior Biostatistician
description:
Senior Biostatistician
All U.S. Locations (remote); candidates must reside in the United States

Position Scope:
The Senior Biostatistician is PaceMate's first biostatistician. The role independently leads the statistical design, analysis, and reporting of PaceMate's clinical research, including internal quality and research studies and externally published work.
The role owns each study from analysis plan through peer-reviewed publication and response to reviewers, working directly with the Chief Medical Officer and PaceMate's clinical team. About a quarter to a third of the role applies the same methods to operational and business questions. Routine operational reporting and dashboards sit outside this role. AI-assisted tools are part of how this role works every day, and the role is accountable for validating every result they help produce. The position has latitude to shape its own workflow and a potential path to expanded oversight of research-related functions.

Essential Functions and Job Responsibilities:

• Write and execute statistical analysis plans for retrospective and real-world evidence studies, including target trial emulation. Define estimands (ICH E9(R1)), cohorts, exposure windows, and outcomes with the Chief Medical Officer and clinical investigators.

• Link and validate multi-table device data. Confirm denominators, person-time, and follow-up, and address left truncation and immortal time bias around device implant and remote monitoring enrollment.

• Analyze count and rate outcomes (Poisson and negative binomial regression with person-time offsets), recurrent events (Andersen-Gill, PWP, and frailty models; mean cumulative function), time-to-event outcomes with competing risks (cause-specific hazards, Fine-Gray, Aalen-Johansen), and clustered data (mixed-effects models, GEE).

• Control confounding with propensity score methods (IPTW, overlap weights, matching). Handle informative censoring with IPCW and missing data with multiple imputation. Test robustness with E-values, negative control outcomes, and tipping-point analyses.

• Write and review methods and results sections for abstracts and peer-reviewed manuscripts to STROBE and RECORD standards. Respond to co-author and external advisor critique.

• Respond to peer review: re-analyses, statistical sections of response letters, and defensible positions under methodological critique.

• Evaluate operational and business changes using interrupted time series, segmented regression, difference-in-differences, and statistical process control. Present effect estimates with confidence intervals to leadership in plain language.

• Use AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT) daily to write, review, debug, and document R and SQL code and analysis reports. Validate all generated code and results before use, and use only PaceMate-approved tools with protected health information.

• Provide statistical input and limited analyses to support quality improvement, patient safety monitoring, and clinical operations when needed. This is not a primary QA role.

• Build reusable research infrastructure with the data science team: standardized cohort definitions, reusable R code, and templated outputs.

• Maintain the analytic queue and the documentation that lets any published result be reproduced by script from the raw data extract.

• Maintain high level understanding of PaceMate products and services.

• Maintain appropriate levels of current knowledge and the ability to interpret, comprehend, and apply policies. Assist in ensuring consistency in practices and PaceMate Mission, Vision, and Customer Service standards are met. Adhere to the Code of Conduct and all Company Policies and Procedures.

Non-Essential Functions:

• When requested, evaluate predictive models for discrimination, calibration, and clinical usefulness (decision curve analysis), in

• You love the loop: idea, ad, result, better idea.
